pages.text: $(italic)Formerly living. Undead mechanics apply. The pack's most punishing race in daylight, most powerful at night.$(/italic)$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Dark Power$(/bold) — +20% damage dealt between 8pm and 4am (in-game time). Stacks with class bonuses.$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$(/bold) — Permanent night vision. No visual difference from Human during the day.$(br2)$(bold)Sunlight Weakness$(/bold) — Direct sunlight: burn effect like a zombie. Helmets and shade prevent this. Plan around it.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Penalty$(/bold) — Natural regen and most healing potions 30% less effective. Life Steal and Paladin auras unaffected.
